tools.name: verify_data_point
tools.description: Paid data verification via x402 (0.01 USDC per call): check a company figure against independent live sources. Returns `verdict` (supported | contradicted | unverified), confidence, sources, conflicts, evidence and summary. The check is numeric: sources are compared against the figures IN your claim

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "verify_data_point" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
